top_choice_rationale: P001 (Mircea Cărtărescu) is the only laureate proposal on the slate and the one I prefer on literary grounds. By public knowledge of Blinding, the first volume of the Orbitor trilogy, and Solenoid, his is a voice I would not find elsewhere. Memory, the body, dream and cosmology are built into one cumulative imaginative architecture, which supports a whole-oeuvre claim on distinctiveness of voice, formal ambition and intellectual depth. I count the unanimous round-2 support for him as no evidence of merit. The citation should name the prose project and its architecture, with the poetry only as its origin, because that is the part the committee can defend. Reservations remain. I judge the Romanian density and rhythm only through translation and secondary description. Whether the later long works enlarge the project or restate its motifs is unresolved, and I have not independently read or verified the works. Adonis remains a very close alternative, and the gap reflects the evidence available to us, not a finding of lesser merit. These uncertainties limit how confidently the claim is stated. They are not strong enough to justify P000 (no award) over a laureate.
